exported=$(nix develop --command printenv BTRC_NATIVE_HEADER_READER)
test "$exported" = "$reader"

test "$selected" = clang' 'nix develop --command make NIX= PYTEST_WORKERS=3 BTRC_TEST_TRANSPILE_TIMEOUT=600 BTRC_TEST_RUN_TIMEOUT=60 test-shard-unit'
